messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
On 16 October 2026, had the time limit within which Member States must notify the Commission of the rules on penalties under Article 50(2) of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 already expired?

response.text: Il 16 ottobre 2026, il termine entro cui gli Stati membri dovevano notificare alla Commissione le norme sulle sanzioni ai sensi dell'articolo 50, paragrafo 2, del regolamento (UE) 2023/1230 era già scaduto?
